tools.description: One saved calculation of an engineering tool (such as drive sizing or safety distance), by its document number or public id: the tool, title and note, whether it is personal or belongs to a project or product, the device it is about, its revision and release state, and its inputs and results. The results are the snapshot the tool computed in the browser when the calculation was saved, with the input and engine versions that produced them; Glados does not compute them again, so a tool changed since may now give other results. Another user's personal calculation is not found. Find the calculations of a project or product with controlled_documents.

document_number.description: The document number, exactly as Glados shows it, as controlled_documents lists it.
document_number.title: Document Number

include_inputs.description: Include the inputs the calculation was made from.
include_inputs.title: Include Inputs

include_results.description: Include the saved results of the calculation.
include_results.title: Include Results

public_id.description: The document's public id, as search or controlled_documents return it.
public_id.title: Public Id

revision.description: The revision to read, such as A or B. Without one, the latest revision is read, which may be a draft; the result lists every revision.

tools.description: The offers of one quote request side by side: per line the item, quantity, state and award, and every supplier's answer for it with lead time, minimum quantity, no offer or an alternative item; per supplier when it was asked and answered and how many lines it priced. Prices appear only where the administrator lets agents see costs. Without a request number it lists the open quote requests.

QuoteRequestStatus.description:
DRAFT until a supplier was sent the request, SENT while lines wait for
an award, AWARDED once every line is awarded or dropped and one was
awarded, CLOSED once someone closed it or dropped every line, CANCELED
once someone canceled it.
QuoteRequestStatus.title: QuoteRequestStatus

limit.description: The most quote requests to return per list.

request_number.description: The quote request number. Without it the tool lists the quote requests so you can pick one.

statuses.description: When listing, only requests in one of these statuses.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.title: Compare offers

tools.description: The checklists, calculations and sequences of a project or product, newest change first, each with document number, revision, whether it is released, superseded or marked invalid, and who holds its edit lock. all_revisions.description: Also earlier revisions, not only the latest revision of each document.

include_product_projects.description: With product_id, also the checklists and calculations of the product's projects.

Earliest desired date first. Use it to check whether a project's parts will arrive or what still needs ordering.

families.description: The demand families to read: bought items, made items and raw material (source) for lots.

include_finished.description: Also list the fulfilled and canceled demands.

tools.name: demand_coverage
tools.title: Demand coverage

tools.description: Submits notes of a meeting, read from what the user gave you such as handwritten notes or a photo, as a draft for the user to review in Glados. It adds to an existing meeting of the project or product (meeting_number) or proposes a new one. Write people exactly as the notes name them; the user matches them to users and contacts. Put what you could not read or had to guess into review_note rather than the text. Nothing changes and nobody is notified until the user applies the draft.

email.description: Only if the notes carry the address.
email.title: Email

name.description: The person exactly as the notes name them, with the company if the notes give it, such as 'Hans M. (Müller GmbH)'. Never guess a full name.
name.title: Name

status.description: present, excused, or distribution_only for someone who only gets the notes.

body.description: What was said, in Markdown: paragraphs, ### headings, **bold**, *italic*, - and 1. lists two levels deep, links. Other syntax shows as plain text. Keep the language of the notes.
body.title: Body

decisions.description: What was decided, one per entry.
decisions.title: Decisions

internal.description: True for points that must not go to people outside.
internal.title: Internal

review_note.description: For the reviewer only, never written to the meeting: what you could not read or had to guess on this card.
review_note.title: Review Note

scope.description: The topic of the card, a few words, such as 'Electrical cabinet'.
scope.title: Scope

scope_icon.description: The icon that fits the topic, if one does.

todos.description: What is to be done, by whom and when.
todos.title: Todos

due_date.description: Only if the notes give a date.
due_date.title: Due Date

owners.description: Who does it, each exactly as the notes name them.
owners.title: Owners

MeetingAttendanceStatus.description:
Present and excused attend or miss the meeting; distribution only
receives the minutes without attending.
MeetingAttendanceStatus.title: MeetingAttendanceStatus

MeetingScopeIcon.description:
The fixed set of icons a card's scope can show. The frontend maps
each identifier to its glyph.
MeetingScopeIcon.title: MeetingScopeIcon

attendees.description: Who attended, was excused or only gets the notes, as the notes list them.
attendees.title: Attendees

cards.description: The notes, one card per topic, in order.
cards.title: Cards

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this one action. Repeating the call with the same key returns the records the first call created instead of creating them again.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

meeting_number.description: The meeting of the project or product to add the notes to, as the meetings tool shows it. Leave it out to propose a new meeting and give new_meeting_name, new_meeting_starts_at and new_meeting_ends_at.
meeting_number.title: Meeting Number

new_meeting_ends_at.description: With its time zone. Without it the meeting ends as it starts.
new_meeting_ends_at.title: New Meeting Ends At

new_meeting_location.description: Where the new meeting took place.
new_meeting_location.title: New Meeting Location

new_meeting_starts_at.description: With its time zone, such as 2026-11-10T09:00:00+01:00.
new_meeting_starts_at.title: New Meeting Starts At

new_meeting_tags.description: Short labels, only if the user asks.
new_meeting_tags.title: New Meeting Tags

next_meeting_date.description: The next meeting's day, if the notes agree one.
next_meeting_date.title: Next Meeting Date

next_meeting_location.description: Where the next meeting takes place.
next_meeting_location.title: Next Meeting Location

next_meeting_time.description: Its local start time, only with next_meeting_date.
next_meeting_time.title: Next Meeting Time

review_note.description: For the reviewer only: anything about the notes as a whole.
review_note.title: Review Note

tools.title: Draft meeting notes

tools.description: Creates a DRAFT production lot for open made item demands of one made item and one project, built from the made item's routing and linked to the demands. The lot waits for a person: they review it in Glados, assign its positions and plan it there. As for a lot created in the web app, inspection steps of the routing queue their inspection orders right away, and the result then names the status.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this one action. Repeating the call with the same key returns the records the first call created instead of creating them again.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

made_demand_ids.description: Made item demands the lot covers, all of one made item and one project; draft one lot per made item and project. Integer demand ids as the demand read tools show them. Only demands that are neither fulfilled nor canceled and still lack pieces are accepted.

note.description: An optional note on the lot.
note.title: Note

quantity.description: The pieces the lot makes. Leave it out to make exactly what the demands still lack; a larger number makes spare pieces.
quantity.title: Quantity

tools.title: Draft a production lot

tools.description: Creates a DRAFT purchase order for one supplier with lines for open bought item and source item demands. Each demand gets the share it still lacks, and demands of one item, unit and project share one line. The order stays a draft: a person reviews it in Glados and places it there; nothing is ordered or sent to the supplier. Each line is added on its own, so if one is refused the result says so and lists the draft with the lines that were added.

bought_demand_ids.description: Bought item demands to cover. Integer demand ids as the demand read tools show them. Only demands that are neither fulfilled nor canceled and still lack pieces are accepted.
bought_demand_ids.title: Bought Demand Ids

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this one action. Repeating the call with the same key returns the records the first call created instead of creating them again.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

note.description: An optional note on the order for the buyer.
note.title: Note

source_demand_ids.description: Source item (raw material) demands to cover. Integer demand ids as the demand read tools show them. Only demands that are neither fulfilled nor canceled and still lack pieces are accepted.
source_demand_ids.title: Source Demand Ids

supplier_id.description: The id of the supplier the order is for, as the read tools show it.
supplier_id.title: Supplier Id

tools.title: Draft a purchase order

A demand share reserves nothing. The request stays a draft: a person reviews it in Glados and sends it to the suppliers there; nothing is sent.

bought_demand_ids.description: Bought item demands to cover. Integer demand ids as the demand read tools show them. Only demands that are neither fulfilled nor canceled and still lack pieces are accepted.

deadline.description: The day by which the suppliers should answer, if any.

note.description: An optional note on the request.
note.title: Note

source_demand_ids.description: Source item (raw material) demands to cover. Integer demand ids as the demand read tools show them. Only demands that are neither fulfilled nor canceled and still lack pieces are accepted.

supplier_ids.description: The ids of the suppliers to ask for an offer, as the read tools show them.
supplier_ids.title: Supplier Ids

Each hit carries the portal part, the bought-item values it would fill (article name, order codes, EAN, manufacturer, product family) and the Glados bought item that already describes it, if any. query.description: With mode 'match', an order number, type number or EPLAN part number. With mode 'search', a number or words of a part's name, such as 'DSNU-25' or 'round cylinder'.

Use it to answer why a lot is late, unplanned, on hold or short. A lot without an approved material source waits for one by design.

tools.description: Looks up a made or bought catalogue item by its part number. A made item comes with its routing (processes in order, with fabrication or inspection method and estimated minutes), its raw material and the list of all its revisions, newest first. A bought item comes with its manufacturer, order codes and status. Use it whenever a part number appears and you need to know what the part is.

part_number.description: The part number of a made or bought item, exactly as Glados shows it.
part_number.title: Part Number

revision.description: A made item's revision, such as 'B'. Leave it out to get the newest revision. Bought items have no revisions and ignore it.
revision.title: Revision

tools.name: item
tools.title: Catalogue item

tools.description: The shortfalls and delays a planner must decide on, computed live: demands open again after lost pieces or a close short, made demands left short by a force completed lot, live lots short of raw material and live lots late against their target date. Sorted by kind, then the earliest target or oldest cause. Use explain_lot on a lot number for the reasons behind one row.

PlanningExceptionKind.description:
LOST_AT_RECEIPT and CLOSED_SHORT: a bought or raw material demand has
a rest open again because its order line lost pieces or was closed
short. LOT_ENDED_SHORT: a made demand's lot was force-completed below
what the demand needs. MATERIAL_SHORT: a live lot's raw material is
partly unallocated or waits on a line without a delivery date, so its
first step cannot be planned in full. LATE: a live lot is past its
target date or planned to end after it.
PlanningExceptionKind.title: PlanningExceptionKind

kind.description: Only this kind. lost_at_receipt and closed_short: a bought or raw material demand is open again because its order line lost pieces or was closed short. lot_ended_short: a made demand's lot was force completed below what it needs. material_short: a live lot's raw material is partly unallocated or waits on a line without a delivery date. late: a live lot is past its target date or planned to end after it.

limit.description: The most rows to return per list.
limit.title: Limit

project_number.description: Only the rows of this project number, matched exactly.
project_number.title: Project Number

tools.name: list_planning_exceptions
tools.title: Planning exceptions

starts_from.description: Only meetings that start on or after this day.

starts_until.description: Only meetings that start on or before this day.
starts_until.title: Starts Until
